test_title: PYST 40 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Price of 5 cups G, H, J, K and L is compared. Price of no two cups is same. Price of K is more than L but less than H and J. Price of G is highest. If the price of H is less than J, then the price of how many cups is more than H?
solution:
Price of K is more than L but less than H and J. 

J/H > K > L

Price of G is highest.

G > _ > _ > _ > _

If the price of H is less than J.

J > H

Combining all the information,

G > J > H > K > L

Price of two cups is more than H.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 1**”.
